quality_assessment: Chapter covers the major output formatting features well, but is missing several important flags and options documented in the codebase. Some explanations could be more complete, particularly for JSON output structure and color specifications.

issues.description: Chapter doesn't document the --color ansi option
issues.should_add: Document --color ansi option in addition to auto/always/never
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'rg --color ansi pattern   # Use ANSI colors only' to the color control examples

issues.description: Hyperlink support is completely missing from the chapter
issues.should_add: Document --hyperlink-format flag for OSC 8 terminal hyperlink support
issues.fix_suggestion: Add new subsection 'Hyperlink Support' explaining --hyperlink-format with examples for clickable file paths in compatible terminals

issues.description: Chapter documents --null and -0 but is missing --null-data flag
issues.should_add: Document --null-data flag which is distinct from --null (affects input line termination)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add example: 'rg --null-data pattern  # Use NUL as line terminator instead of newline'

issues.description: Missing --include-zero flag for including files with zero matches
issues.fix_suggestion: Add to Standard Output Format section: 'rg --include-zero pattern  # Include files with zero matches in output'

issues.description: Pretty printing flag -p/--pretty is not documented
issues.should_add: Document -p/--pretty flag as alternative to --json -p shown in example
issues.fix_suggestion: Update JSON output section to explicitly mention '-p' or '--pretty' as a dedicated flag, not just as an option combined with --json

issues.description: Chapter only lists 4 color types (match, path, line, column) but implementation likely has more
issues.current_content:
Available color types:
- `match`: Matching text
- `path`: File paths
- `line`: Line numbers
- `column`: Column numbers
issues.should_be: Should document all available color types from ColorSpecs data structure
issues.fix_suggestion: Verify complete list of color types from codebase and add any missing ones (e.g., context, error, etc.)

issues.description: Chapter mentions message types but doesn't explain them in detail
issues.current_content:
Each match is represented as a JSON object with fields including:
- `type`: The type of message (match, context, begin, end, summary)
- `data`: Match data including path, line number, text, and submatches
issues.should_be: Should explain what each message type represents and when it appears
issues.fix_suggestion: Add detailed explanation of each JSON message type: 'match' for matches, 'context' for context lines, 'begin' for file start, 'end' for file end, 'summary' for search summary
issues.source_reference: features.json:173 - JSON Lines format, features.json:480 - JSON (JSON output printer)

issues.should_add: Document -N/--no-line-number flag to explicitly disable line numbers
issues.fix_suggestion: Add example: 'rg -N pattern  # Disable line numbers'

issues.description: Missing --with-filename and --no-filename flags for controlling file path display
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection explaining how to control file path display with --with-filename and --no-filename, noting auto-detection behavior
Add example showing --context-separator usage for customizing separator between context groups

positive_aspects: Clear structure with logical progression from basic to advanced options
Good examples for each feature area
Helpful 'Best Practices' section with actionable advice
Well-organized with proper headings and code blocks
improvement_suggestions: Add comprehensive table of all output-related flags at the beginning
Expand JSON output section with complete schema documentation
Add troubleshooting subsection for common output formatting issues
Include examples of combining multiple output options
Add cross-references to context-lines.md for context-related flags
Consider adding a visual diagram showing output format anatomy
Add note about terminal compatibility for features like hyperlinks and colors
